home.domainsHeading: Five consulting domains. One engineering standard.
home.thesisHeading: Quality is not a phase. It is a property of how you build.
thesisBody: Most organisations treat quality as inspection: build first, test at the end, hope for the best. The result is the QA bottleneck — releases queuing behind test cycles, defects found when they are most expensive to fix.

We work from a different premise. Quality is engineered into strategy, architecture, and pipeline from the first commit — so testing confirms confidence instead of manufacturing it. That is what turns quality from a cost center into delivery speed.
Troventis is deliberately boutique: senior expertise on every engagement, direct collaboration without account layers, and partners we trust when initiatives scale.

about.metaDescription: Troventis is a founder-led boutique technology consultancy based in Frankfurt am Main, focused on software quality engineering.
about.label: 05 · about
about.heading: About Troventis
about.intro: Troventis is a founder-led boutique technology consultancy based in Frankfurt am Main — founded in 2026 on a simple conviction: software quality is not a promise, it is an outcome you can prove.
story: Behind Troventis are more than ten years of enterprise software quality engineering experience — across international teams, large software landscapes, and projects where reliability is not a nice-to-have.

That experience made a gap visible: many organizations buy consulting at corporate scale and receive junior teams. Troventis inverts that model — deliberately boutique, with senior expertise in every engagement and trusted partners joining as projects grow.
The name is the program: we verify instead of promising. Every delivery is reviewed, tested, and transparently documented.
about.founderBio: Software quality engineer with over ten years of experience in test strategy, test automation, and quality processes for enterprise applications — from telecommunications to the public sector.

approach.metaTitle: Our Approach – Discover, Assess, Design, Deliver, Optimize | Troventis
approach.metaDescription: The Troventis consulting method: five phases from discovery to sustained capability — every phase ends with something verifiable.
approach.label: 02 · approach
approach.heading: A method, not a mystery
approach.intro: Consulting is often bought on trust and delivered as a black box. We work the other way around: a transparent five-phase method where every phase ends with something verifiable — and nothing ends with a slide deck alone.

phases.title: Discover
phases.body: We start by understanding your delivery reality — systems, teams, constraints, and goals. Stakeholder conversations and codebase review, not assumptions. You get a shared, written problem definition.

phases.title: Assess
phases.body: We evaluate your quality posture end to end: strategy, test coverage, automation, pipeline, architecture, and team practice. Honest findings, ranked by risk and business impact — including what is already working.

phases.title: Design
phases.body: We design the target state and a pragmatic route to it: quality gates, automation architecture, tooling decisions, and the team model to sustain them. Ambitious enough to matter, realistic enough to ship.

phases.title: Deliver
phases.body: We implement alongside your team — senior, hands-on execution with knowledge transfer built into daily work. Progress lands in your repository and pipeline, not in status reports.

phases.title: Optimize
phases.body: We measure what changed, tune what needs it, and hand over deliberately. Quality metrics, documentation, and practiced routines that outlive the engagement.

approach.closing: Every phase ends with something verifiable. No phase ends with a slide deck alone.

industries.metaTitle: Industries – Engineering Consulting for Finance, Telco & Public Sector | Troventis
industries.metaDescription: How Troventis adapts quality engineering to regulated and demanding domains: financial services, telecommunications, public sector, healthcare, manufacturing, SaaS.
industries.label: 03 · industries
industries.heading: Engineering practices are universal. Their constraints are not.
industries.intro: Good engineering travels across domains — but every industry has its own regulatory, technical, and organisational reality. We adapt quality engineering to that reality instead of forcing one template on all of them.

items.title: Financial services
items.constraint: Regulation, auditability, and zero tolerance for defective releases.
items.adaptation: Traceable quality gates, risk-based test strategies, and documentation that satisfies auditors without slowing engineers.

items.title: Telecommunications
items.constraint: Massive scale, dense system integration, and long-lived legacy landscapes.
items.adaptation: Automation platforms built for API and integration complexity, anchored in CI/CD — proven in our own telco project work.

items.title: Public sector
items.constraint: Procurement rules, compliance requirements, and decade-long system lifecycles.
items.adaptation: Sustainable, vendor-independent QA structures and advisory that survives staff and supplier changes — grounded in our public sector consulting experience.

items.title: Healthcare
items.constraint: Patient safety, standards compliance, and validated processes.
items.adaptation: Documented verification, rigorous traceability from requirement to test, and process discipline without process theater.

items.title: Manufacturing & IoT
items.constraint: Software meeting hardware — physical constraints, embedded interfaces, field conditions.
items.adaptation: System integration testing across the hardware/software boundary and test strategies for what cannot be fully simulated.

items.title: SaaS & e-commerce
items.constraint: Release velocity, conversion risk, and users one click from a competitor.
items.adaptation: Continuous testing that keeps pace with daily deploys, performance engineering, and quality signals wired into the release decision.
